items.title: How an ad break works with SSAI
steps: The viewer reaches an ad break
The stream server asks the ad server for ads
The ad decision picks ads for the pod
The ads are stitched into the stream
The viewer sees the ads as part of the show
items.why: The server picks and stitches the ads, so the viewer’s device just plays one stream.
